title: ClawMem shared-brain lifecycle architecture
summary: Stub evidence: ClawMem appears to differentiate by combining local shared memory with hook-driven lifecycle automation and an optional MCP surface.

claims.claim: ClawMem uses a local shared SQLite/WAL vault so multiple coding agents can access the same memory base.
ClawMem's differentiator is hook/plugin-driven lifecycle automation for pre-fetch, post-turn capture, and pre-compress, not MCP alone.
